statement: A test-only DS4 split evdev gamepad-plus-touch run produced one ten-second SDL 3.2.0 gamepad/rumble success, but a reported display crash interrupted the intended three runs; acceptance remained blocked.

applicability.revision: virtualgamepad alpha-1 historical observation, pinned document c60c1640
applicability.scope: Linux 6.12.107 arm64. Cause of display crash unknown; no isolated repeat, touch consumer validation or production adoption proved.
